item.title: Arknights: Endfield players hit with extra PayPal charges at launch
item.description: Players of the newly launched action RPG Arknights: Endfield were hit with payment problems last week that led to some being overcharged hundreds of dollars when making PayPal transactions. Almost four years after its reveal, Gryphline’s latest gacha game launched globally on Thursday, January 22nd, but a payments glitch quickly arose. ... [MORE]

item.title: Couch Party! wins the Very Big Indie Pitch at Pocket Gamer Connects Aqaba 2025
item.description: Couch Party! secured first place at the Very Big Indie Pitch during Pocket Gamer Connects Aqaba. The event series returned to Pocket Gamer Connects Aqbaba for another year of fast-paced, pitching action among all of the indie developers participating. ... [MORE]

item.title: Meet the world’s leading mobile game companies in San Francisco
item.description: On March 9th, Pocket Gamer Connects returns to the US for a focused, high-impact Summit bringing the mobile games industry together. Last year’s attendees included many of the world’s leading mobile game publishers, developers, investors, platforms, and service and tool providers, offering a clear snapshot of the sort of companies you can meet again in 2026. ... [MORE]

item.title: Vietnam’s Panthera Global raises $1.5m to scale mid-core RPG ambitions
item.description: Vietnam-based mobile studio Panthera Global has raised $1.5 million to accelerate its growth and build more sustainable games. The developer will also use the seed funding to support team expansion, strengthen data analytics, and advance multiple mid-core RPGs into global soft launch and live operations. ... [MORE]

item.title: Godot 4.6 launches with focus on performance and workflow polish
item.description: Open-source engine Godot has launched Godot 4.6 to mark the start of a new development phase focused on performance optimisation. Released less than six months after the previous major update, the company said Godot 4.6 is positioned as a refinement-driven release aimed at improving everyday workflows. ... [MORE]

item.title: Stray Fawn and Sidekick Publishing partner on roguelike chess-builder Gambonanza
item.description: Indie game studio Stray Fawn and Sidekick Publishing have penned a global co-publishing partnership for an upcoming roguelike chess-builder titled Gambonanza. Developed by solo creator Paul Giovannini of Blukulélé Studio, Gambonanza’s March 2025 trailer has reached 560,000 views, with a public Steam playtest now live ahead of its PC and mobile release. ... [MORE]

item.title: Women in Games launches Manifesto 2026 to push for gender fairness
item.description: Women in Games has launched the Women in Games Manifesto 2026 to improve gender representation and greater fairness across the games industry. The manifesto noted that although women make up almost half of gamers, far fewer work in the games industry, and that fixing this imbalance is essential for the future of games. ... [MORE]

item.title: Monetisation trends to watch in 2026: "Player expectations have changed"
item.description: Panellists at Pocket Gamer Connects London took to the stage last week to decode monetisation trends, exploring what’s worked in the past, the current landscape, and what to expect in 2026. Speakers included Crackle co-founder Jaivir Nagi, Merso.io CEO David Perez-Iturralde, gamesconsulting.net F2P design and product consultant Nick Murray, Fumb Games CEO Paul West, and Reactional Music CEO Matt Connors. ... item.title: Yodo1 launches IPVerse platform for in-game IP licensing
item.description: Yodo1 Games has launched a free data intelligence platform for IP and licensing named IPVerse. The company said IPVerse is designed to help game developers make in-game collaborations using global and regional data instead of guesswork. ... [MORE]
